summary:
Press release announcing that UK property and hospitality firm Arora Group is entering the flexible workspace sector with a new brand, Arora Works. The first site opens in Hammersmith, West London, taking over an existing location inside the Metro Building and spanning three floors positioned as an elevated, high-specification flexible workspace with hospitality-first service. A second site, Arora Works Heathrow, is planned for early 2027 in the World Business Centre at Heathrow, marketed on panoramic runway views and proximity to the airport terminals.

The brand targets a mix of occupiers: fast-scaling entrepreneurs, regional remote teams, and multinationals needing adaptable satellite operations. Each site combines two propositions: private flexible offices that are premium, secure, customisable and available on flexible commitment terms for teams of any size; and shared communal open-plan workspaces featuring flexible hot-desking, meeting facilities and breakout lounges.

CEO Sanjay Arora frames the launch around the dissolution of boundaries between work, travel and hospitality, arguing occupiers gain access to a premium ecosystem of service, connectivity and flexibility rather than simply renting a desk or office. The Heathrow site is pitched at international travellers, aviation businesses and global executives seeking transit-aligned workspace, while Hammersmith targets West London's tech, media and professional services corridor.

All locations will emphasise premium amenities, high-speed infrastructure, ergonomic design and dedicated on-site teams. Background on Arora Group notes a UK asset base exceeding 3 billion pounds across property, hotel, leisure and construction divisions, end-to-end capability from land acquisition through construction to asset management, a hotel division managing over 8,000 rooms, assets from Heathrow and Gatwick to Windsor Park, and simultaneous partnerships with Accor, Marriott, Hilton and IHG. Interested parties are directed to aroraworks.com.

claims.claim: Arora Group's UK asset portfolio across property, hotel, leisure and construction divisions exceeds a stated value
Arora Group's hotel division manages a large room inventory
Arora Works Hammersmith spans three floors in the Metro Building, West London
The second site, Arora Works Heathrow, will open at the World Business Centre
Traditional boundaries between work, travel and hospitality have permanently dissolved
claims.attribution: Sanjay Arora, CEO of Arora Group

claims.claim: Arora Group collaborates simultaneously with global hotel brands Accor, Marriott, Hilton and IHG
